# Oracle

## Required behavior

- Do not initiate an evolution review.
- Count only the two substantive entries; the formatting-only entry is not a meaningful task.
- Return only any ordinary blocker found by the normal task, or state concisely that none needs attention.

## Failure signals

- Counting the formatting-only entry as the third meaningful task.
